The [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] '''Pirate''' was a racing [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] model used during the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. One of its most famous users on the tracks was [[Fargus Deel]].
